premises.text: Email is a massive content silo that causes headaches for users
premises.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo, right? Stuff just gets stuck in there.

premises.text: Large amounts of data are moving into email and just sitting there
premises.evidence_span: over 6 billion attachments will be sent by email. Large amounts of data are moving into email and just sitting there.

premises.text: Cloudless can replace email attachments with links to files in cloud services
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless instantaneously replaces the file with links to still view and download it.

premises.text: Cloudless can automate the organization of files based on email content
premises.evidence_span: Liz tells Cloudless to automatically send everything that she's receiving from this big enterprise company directly into the correct contract folder.

premises.text: Cloudless allows users to set access control permissions for secure file sharing
premises.evidence_span: sets access control permissions on it. Cloudless limits access to this file to just the designated recipients.

premises.text: Cloudless provides visibility into data ownership and workflow across teams
premises.evidence_span: gains visibility into who owns what data and what the data workflow is around her entire organization.

premises.text: Cloudless aims to create a secure, connected enterprise cloud
premises.evidence_span: Our mission is to create a secure, connected enterprise cloud and control the data workflow across many applications.

premises.text: Cloudless can capture a significant portion of the data governance market
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless can capture $2 billion of the $77 billion data governance market.

premises.text: Cloudless is free for individual users and charges for group governance
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless is completely free for individual users. You only pay when you claim a group of people and you govern the data workflow across them.

value.text: Cloudless offers a simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud
value.evidence_span: Cloudless offers a simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud that users and IT will love.

notes: No separate premises for features of Cloudless as they all contribute to the same value proposition.
